title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there
  • Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with min…

title: Stage - Assistant Conformité & Modération de Contenu (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
description:
Au sein de l'équipe Content Moderation de Doctolib, vous jouez un rôle concret dans la fiabilité de notre plateforme. En veillant à la conformité des contenus publiés sur nos services, vous contribuez directement à maintenir la confiance de millions de patients et de professionnels de santé en Europe. Véritable bras droit de la manager, vous participez à la fois au bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'équipe et à des projets stratégiques transverses — une expérience polyvalente, au cœur d'un enjeu clé pour Doctolib.


Vos missions

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Participer à la modération du contenu au quotidien
  • Mettre à jour régulièrement les nouveautés de l’équipe sur l'intranet
  • Réaliser une veille quotidienne sur les nouveaux actes, termes et pratiques à modérer sur les profils praticiens
  • Réaliser une veille réglementaire sur les sujets liés au droit d’exercer des soignants
  • Rédiger des templates à faire relire par les équipes Legal en vue de missions de mise en conformité

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en Master (Bac+4/Bac+5) dans une école de commerce ou de communication
  • Vous êtes organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), à l'aise pour gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle 
  • Vous avez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse 
  • Vous aimez travailler en transversal avec différentes équipes et vous adapter à un environnement dynamique 

Ce serait fantastique si :

  • Vous avez une formation complémentaire en droit, type bachelor en droit

title: Strategic Partnerships Manager, France
description:
About the Team
 We are hiring a Partnerships Manager based in France with primary responsibility for the French market. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.
 About the Role
 You will manage relationships with strategic partners in France and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for France, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.
 Please note, this role is based in Paris with 3 days per week required in the office.
 In this role, you will:
 Own partnership strategy and execution for France, driving end-to-end partnership development and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities
 Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.
 Lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.
 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.
